system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: Jirayu and one partner applied to register a private limited company with two promoters on 15 December 2022, and applied again with the same composition on 15 March 2023. Which application was permissible and which was not? Answer briefly with reasons.
raw_response:
- Not permissible: 15 December 2022. At that time, Section 1097 of the Civil and Commercial Code (pre‑amendment) required at least three persons to subscribe the memorandum and promote a limited company; two promoters were insufficient.

- Permissible: 15 March 2023. From 7 February 2023, Section 1097 CCC as amended by the Act Amending the Civil and Commercial Code (No. 23) B.E. 2565 (2022) allows “two or more persons” to form a limited company, so two promoters suffice.
